realized_metrics.window_convention: WP-12bh / WP-S2c-25 uses the next prior contiguous equivalent-length non-cloned evaluation window, 2024-04-12 through 2025-04-11, as the second additional H-005 D2 observation after the original full-period no-formal-split baseline. Indicators are warmed up on prior available history, but the backtest window starts flat with no pre-window position carry-in. The original H-005 REP-0001 evidence used a full-period retrospective posture, so strict non-overlap against that baseline is impossible; this report records explicit non-cloned bounded-window disclosure for additional REP evidence.

metric_comparisons.comparison_notes: D2-006 requires out-of-sample Sharpe >= 1.0 net of modeled costs; OL-0021 records sharpe below that threshold.
D2-006 requires DSR > 1.0 at 95% confidence given actual trial count; OL-0021 records dsr below that threshold.
D2-006 requires max drawdown <= 20% in any walk-forward fold; OL-0021 records max_drawdown above that threshold.
D2-006 requires parameter sensitivity min_ratio >= 0.70; OL-0021 records sensitivity_min_ratio below that threshold.
D2-006 requires walk-forward efficiency > 0.5; OL-0021 records walk_forward_efficiency below that threshold.
